newsitem.title: UK: Great Portland sets 4-for-25 rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Great Portland sets 4-for-25 rights issue.

text.p: British property development company Great Portland Estates Plc said on Tuesday it was offering new ordinary shares at 190p each in a four-for-25 rights issue.
The company said in a statement the funds raised would enable it to take advantage of opportunities in the market.
It said the investment and letting markets continued to have a firm underlying tone and earnings for the second half would be broadly similar to the first half.

Great Portland said it was offering 52,007,754 new ordinary shares, payable in full by no later than February 18. Trading in the shares was expected to begin on January 29, Great Portland said in the statement.
The company said cash resources totalled 32 million stg at present. Undrawn medium-term bank facilities totalled 25 million stg.
